unavailable_resources.description: Access failures: exact resources verified unreachable. Distinct from pedagogical unsuitability.

unsuitable_resources.description: Pedagogical unsuitability: selected resources judged wrong for the learner, though still accessible. Drives structural replacement, not access filtering.

prerequisite_repairs.description: Explicit repair mapping: failed prerequisite name to the route_id of the eligible intervention resource that repairs it. Prerequisite repair never invents this mapping.
